beats.world_change: objective advances; corridor door highlighted by flicker-fix

beats.story_event: Someone kept the lights alive on an emergency circuit

beats.world_change: water level animates down; stair opening revealed
beats.audio: valve ratchet turns, water rush draining, level drops
beats.animation: valve wheel rotation; water plane translate; gate bars lift
beats.visual_feedback: waterline falls; splash sounds; door light

beats.story_event: The nest: someone lived here keeping the pumps alive; the last note explains the sealed tunnel
beats.world_change: scripted beat: single thud + string lights dip
beats.audio: radio static loop, drip field; scripted thud + flicker
beats.next_objective: O6 shut down the master breaker

beats.world_change: pumps stop; hum dies; station goes to emergency lighting; winch gate armed
beats.audio: big clunk; hum spools down to silence; distant water shifts
beats.animation: lever rotation; gate status lamp turns green
beats.visual_feedback: darkness + red e-light; gate floodlight turns on (own circuit)
beats.next_objective: O7 crank the service gate and climb out

beats.story_event: Escape + payoff: gate cranks open, ladder to dawn
beats.world_change: gate rises; dawn sky visible; ending card
